states.claim: device is detached from the device list (list_del_rcu on device->dev_list) and its dev_alloc_list is removed when writeable.
device is closed via btrfs_close_bdev and then freed via btrfs_free_device; after this point device is no longer a valid object.
cur_devices is set to device->fs_devices, the fs_devices owning the device.
cur_devices may be closed and freed when it has no open devices.
fs_devices is initialized to fs_info->fs_devices and is the parent fs_devices.
uuid_mutex is acquired at function entry and released on the out path; it is temporarily released around btrfs_shrink_device and reacquired.
fs_info->chunk_mutex is acquired and released around modification of device->dev_alloc_list and rw_devices.
fs_devices->device_list_mutex is acquired and released around device list and super_copy num_devices updates.
device->bdev is a block device reference; when non-NULL, cur_devices->open_devices is decremented and the sysfs entry is removed.
device->bdev and device->name are used for scratch superblocks when the device is writeable.
device->dev_state has BTRFS_DEV_STATE_IN_FS_METADATA cleared after btrfs_rm_dev_item succeeds.
device->dev_state is tested for BTRFS_DEV_STATE_REPLACE_TGT, BTRFS_DEV_STATE_WRITEABLE, and BTRFS_DEV_STATE_MISSING to gate removal and accounting.
device->fs_devices->rw_devices is decremented when the device is writeable and re-incremented on error_undo.
device->dev_alloc_list is re-added to fs_devices->alloc_list on error_undo when the device is writeable.
fs_info->super_copy num_devices is decremented by one and updated via btrfs_set_super_num_devices.
cur_devices->num_devices, total_devices, and missing_devices are decremented during device removal.
fs_devices->total_devices is decremented when cur_devices differs from fs_devices (seed device case).
cur_devices->seed_list is removed from the list before closing/freeing cur_devices.

values.claim: num_devices is initialized to the device count returned by btrfs_num_devices(fs_info).
The RAID minimum-device check is performed with num_devices - 1, i.e. the device count after removing one device.
num_devices is recomputed as the superblock device count minus 1 and written back to the superblock.
When cur_devices differs from fs_devices, fs_devices->total_devices is also decremented by one.
cur_devices->missing_devices is decremented by one when the device is in the MISSING state.
cur_devices->open_devices is decremented by one when device->bdev is non-NULL.
cur_devices is closed and freed when cur_devices->open_devices equals 0.
fs_info->fs_devices->rw_devices is decremented by one when the device is writeable.
device->fs_devices->rw_devices is incremented by one on the error_undo path when the device is writeable.
Removal is rejected with BTRFS_ERROR_DEV_ONLY_WRITABLE when the device is writeable and fs_info->fs_devices->rw_devices equals 1.

executions.claim: Continuing past the replace-target check implies BTRFS_DEV_STATE_REPLACE_TGT is not set in device->dev_state; otherwise execution goes to out.
Continuing past the only-writable check implies not (BTRFS_DEV_STATE_WRITEABLE is set in device->dev_state and fs_info->fs_devices->rw_devices == 1); otherwise execution goes to out.

If BTRFS_DEV_STATE_WRITEABLE is set in device->dev_state, then under chunk_mutex the device is removed from dev_alloc_list and device->fs_devices->rw_devices is decremented before unlocking chunk_mutex.
After btrfs_shrink_device(device, 0), if ret is nonzero execution goes to error_undo; if ret is zero, btrfs_reada_remove_dev(device) is called before reacquiring uuid_mutex.
After btrfs_rm_dev_item(device), if ret is nonzero execution goes to error_undo; otherwise execution continues to clear BTRFS_DEV_STATE_IN_FS_METADATA and cancel scrub for device.

At this point cur_devices is assigned from device->fs_devices; under fs_devices->device_list_mutex, device is removed from dev_list, cur_devices->num_devices and cur_devices->total_devices are decremented, and if cur_devices != fs_devices then fs_devices->total_devices is also decremented.
If BTRFS_DEV_STATE_MISSING is set in device->dev_state, cur_devices->missing_devices is decremented.
If device->bdev is non-NULL, cur_devices->open_devices is decremented and the sysfs entry for device is removed.
Under fs_devices->device_list_mutex, num_devices is set to btrfs_super_num_devices(fs_info->super_copy) - 1 and written back to fs_info->super_copy before unlocking.
If BTRFS_DEV_STATE_WRITEABLE is set in device->dev_state, btrfs_scratch_superblocks is called with fs_info, device->bdev, and device->name->str.
After btrfs_close_bdev(device), synchronize_rcu(), and btrfs_free_device(device), if cur_devices->open_devices == 0 then cur_devices is removed from seed_list, closed, and freed.

At error_undo, btrfs_reada_undo_remove_dev(device) is called; if BTRFS_DEV_STATE_WRITEABLE is set in device->dev_state, under chunk_mutex device is added back to fs_devices->alloc_list and device->fs_devices->rw_devices is incremented.
